relations: 雇主/下属转为朋友：Rogue 与 Kayla——Kayla 是在 Rogue 店里的雇员，本章当面辞职；Rogue 承诺改日去看她，并为她向警方撒谎。原文："All right, well, I guess you're fired." / "Actually, I quit." / "I will be furious I have lost you for a few days, but I'll get over it. I also know where you are, so I plan to come and visit on my days off."

伴侣：Ares 与 Kayla——Ares 自称在努力当好 boyfriend，Kayla 要求先别告诉另外三人。原文："I was improvising, trying to be a good boyfriend." / "Can we not mention the boyfriend thing to the others yet?" / "We will protect her with our lives—that I can promise you."
敌对/前任：Kayla 与 Aaron——Rogue 直称 Aaron 是"her douchebag ex"，Kayla 坚称他回不来。原文："since you were not told about her douchebag ex, I will give you a free pass this time." / "he can't come back"

上下级/敌对：Rogue 与两名便衣警察——她谎称 Kayla 请病假、两人上周才见过，隐瞒了岛的存在。原文："Two men came in yesterday, cops in plain clothes, and they were asking about you." / "I told them you called in sick and that I hadn't seen you since last week. I didn't mention the island or anything else."

同谋/敌对：Ares 与 Clay、Brawley——Ares 替两人对 Aaron 动手一事遮掩并准备把 Aaron 从系统里抹掉。原文："deep down knowing what Clay and Brawley did to him" / "we will lawyer up" / "In a few short hours, every trace of Aaron will be wiped from our system, but thankfully he was there under an alias"

facts.fact: Ares 清晨清掉监控日志里 Luca 在这里工作过的所有痕迹，并把有他的录像循环覆盖以防日后被翻出来。
facts.anchor: I went over the logs this morning and erased all traces of Luca working here, looping any footage with him in it

facts.fact: Ares 在岛上的住户档案里调出 Kayla 的档案，鼠标停在 background check 上，随即点出档案放弃查阅。
facts.anchor: I hover the cursor over the background check, then quickly click out of her file

facts.fact: Ares 决定不再查她的档案而是直接问她，记起 Brawley 关于「总有一天会走进来一个不合适的人」的警告。
facts.anchor: If I need to know something, she said I could ask her, and that is what I plan to do.

facts.fact: Kayla 请 Ares 开车送她进城去见 Rogue；Vero 被拦下，因为 Rogue 不是他的拥趸。
facts.anchor: Can you drive me into town today? I need to go see Rogue.

facts.fact: Kayla 当面告诉 Rogue 她不干了；Rogue 说「I guess you're fired」，Kayla 纠正为「Actually, I quit.」
Rogue 告诉 Kayla：昨天有两个便衣警察来问过她的事，她当时谎称 Kayla 请病假、自己上周才见过她，并且没有提岛。
facts.anchor: Two men came in yesterday, cops in plain clothes, and they were asking about you.

facts.fact: Kayla 对 Ares 承认警察在找 Aaron，并说她明明知道 Clay 和 Brawley 对他做了什么却一直装没看见。
facts.anchor: I turned a blind eye, while deep down knowing what Clay and Brawley did to him, but this is a lot to take in and it’s all hitting me at once.

facts.fact: Ares 要 Kayla 记住自己什么都没见过、什么都不知道的说法，并承诺会处理此事。
